title: 3-Pair MisGAN: Neural Imputer on Ambiguous Single-Sensor Queries
intuition: Grades the actual trained neural imputer G_i([x*m, m, z_i]) directly on held-out ambiguous single-sensor queries WITHOUT posterior resampling fallback: must preserve observed entries to 1e-6 and calibrate missing-coordinate spread (ratio in [0.7, 1.3]).
failure_mode: Neural imputers collapse to deterministic conditional means (missing_std_ratio << 0.7) on ambiguous queries or perturb already-observed coordinates.
protocol_notes: Tier-4 held benchmark (7,000 updates); strictly forbids posterior-resampling fallback.
